title: parse_sse_block: bare 'id:' stores Some('') causing empty Last-Event-ID on reconnect
description: RFC 8895 §9.2 allows 'id:' with no value; this resets last-event-id to empty string. parse_sse_block strip_prefix('id:') + trim() yields Some('') for this case. RFC 8620 §7.3 says clients send Last-Event-ID on reconnect; sending 'Last-Event-ID: ' (empty value) may be rejected by the server or cause incorrect resume behavior. The fix: map Some('') to None, or only set id when the stripped value is non-empty.
